reviewer: Claude (vision, subjective - not a programmatic check). Owner still approves.

findings.note: Frame crosses wheels, forming narrow slivers.
Each wheel must be one complete clean circle with a small round hub at its centre; the frame, fork and rear stays may only touch a wheel at its hub, and no frame line may cross a wheel outline.
Avoid narrow wedge-shaped gaps between frame and wheel; every enclosed area must be wide enough to colour.
